worldcombat.skill.moonblast.summary: Gather the moonlight overhead into an orb and fire it: fairy special damage that may lower the target's Sp. Atk. Open night skies feed it the most, raising power, drop chance and glow; in daylight or indoors it is an ordinary orb. The condensed form is heavier with a better drop, the streaming form faster and wider.
worldcombat.skill.moonblast.use.0: Fire the heaviest fairy shot under an open night sky
worldcombat.skill.moonblast.use.1: Suppress a special threat from range
worldcombat.skill.moonblast.use.2: Take a chance at shaving a stage of Sp. Atk
The moon orb deals %1$s fairy special damage on impact.
On a hit it has a %1$s chance to lower the target's Sp. Atk by %2$s stage(s).
The moonlight overhead is currently %1$s: highest when open to the sky at night with little rain, raising both power and drop chance.
It bursts into a crescent about %1$s blocks across and spreads %2$s rays.
worldcombat.skill.moonblast.option.on: Condensed form: a denser orb and a better drop chance, at the cost of a slower flight, longer wind-up and cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.moonblast.option.off: Streaming form: a faster orb with a wider burst, at the cost of power and drop chance.
worldcombat.skill.moonblast.timing: Range %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.moonblast.growth.0: From level %1$s the moonlit power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.moonblast.growth.1: From level %1$s the burst spreads %2$s rays.
worldcombat.skill.moonblast.preference.c: On: a denser orb with power x1.12 and drop chance +0.06, at the cost of flight speed x0.85, +2 ticks wind-up and +3 ticks cooldown, harder to dodge. Off (streaming form): flight speed x1.15 and burst radius x1.15, at the cost of power x0.9 and drop chance -0.04, for a quick wide hit.
worldcombat.skill.moonblast.preference.a: It only considers loosing the orb when a threat is within this distance; smaller values keep it close, larger ones let it open fire from further out.
